name: SDM Kinematics
description: Sun Devil Motorsports suspension-kinematics tool (OptimumKinematics-class): double-wishbone + U-bar/ARB model in OptimumK global coordinates, hardpoint editor, live 3D suspension with roll-center/IC overlays, Newton-Raphson position solver, heave/roll/pitch/steer sweeps, OptimumK Excel/JSON import + SDM Excel export, multi-parameter evolutionary optimizer with actuation-plane constraints, and auto-generated PDF study reports. Sandboxed; declares file.write for exports.
